description: Install the user's SSH PUBLIC key on their website pilot and return its SSH connection instructions. Only the website pilot is externally SSH-accessible. The database remains private and is reachable through the website. Generate an Ed25519 key locally if needed; send only its public key, never its private key. The gateway and controller private keys are never returned. Inspect get_private_vps_action for the result.
name: get_private_vps_ssh
title: Get website pilot SSH access
